## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally
- [ ] Changeset added (`npm run changeset`) if `packages/*/src` changed
- [ ] Public API change: snapshot in `packages/react/test/__snapshots__` updated deliberately
- [ ] Breaking change: ADR or `docs/guides/migration.md` updated and a deprecation notice shipped first
- [ ] Accessibility: keyboard, focus, screen-reader name verified; axe test added
- [ ] Colour: only `--mn-*` variables; no raw values
- [ ] Visual change: described in this PR (maintainers regenerate the visual baselines; do not commit screenshots from your own machine)
